prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Evidence is still thin across all change types; at least 2 tests of a kind are required to establish a rule.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_screen: -4.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 60.9%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 17.8%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [choose_path, redesign] Redesign Story Screen with Split Layout: Redesign the opening story screen using a split layout with companion imagery and clear intro text. (why: The choose_path step has a mean duration of 514s and 23.8% drop-off, indicating potential friction on initial welcome screens.)
1: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign In After Pet Selection: Move the sign_in step after pet creation screens so users pick their pet before registering. (why: Sign-in currently drops 27.1% of users right after path selection. Letting users choose a pet first increases motivation to sign in.)
2: [finish, new_screen] Add Desktop Placement Checklist Screen: Insert a new screen before home_intro that guides users through desktop permissions and visibility setup. (why: Support received 3 emails reporting pets not appearing on desktop and 3 emails reporting confusion about desktop controls.)
3: [adoption, new_flow] Add Custom Pet Guidelines Sub Flow: Insert a photo guidelines screen before photo upload to explain optimal pet photo lighting and pose. (why: Support received 3 bug reports about custom pet generation failing or looking wrong, and adoption stage conversion is low at 60.9%.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Add Account Persistence Warning on Sign In: Display a hint on the sign-in screen clarifying that pet data connects directly to the authenticated account. (why: Support received 8 emails regarding pets missing or resetting after logging in with a different account.)
5: [home, wait_info] Add Generation Status Progress Bar: Show dynamic time estimates and progress info on the waiting screen during pet rendering. (why: The waiting step has a median time of 201s and mean of 2336s, creating drop-off due to unknown wait times.)
6: [home, notification] Desktop Ready Background Notification: Enable background completion notifications on the waiting screen so users can minimize the app. (why: Users wait an average of 2336s on the waiting screen, leading to abandonment before setup finishes.)
7: [adoption, layout] Two Column Adoption Certificate Layout: Change the adoption certificate screen layout to two_column for a cleaner certificate presentation. (why: Adoption stage has the lowest step conversion rate at 60.9% and takes a long mean time of 1017s.)
8: [finish, copy] Clear Desktop Control Quick Reference: Update home_intro text to clearly detail how to right-click, hide, or talk to the pet once on desktop. (why: Support received 3 emails from users confused about how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup.)

scores.note: Addresses 23.8% drop-off and 514s duration on initial welcome, but evidence relies solely on funnel data.
Sign-in drops 27.1% of users; deferring friction until after investment usually boosts sign-in conversion.
Supported by 35.2% finish drop-off and 6 support emails, but adding new screens carries release overhead and mixed confidence.
Targets highest drop step (39.1%) with 3 support reports, but prior test of new screens in adoption yielded -4.2% lift.
Strong evidence with 8 support emails and 27.1% sign-in drop-off; cheap to implement via text/hint config.
Home step has long wait times (mean 2336s); progress indicators reliably reduce perceived wait frustration.
Helps recover users abandoning during 2336s mean wait time, though requires native notification release.
Targets largest drop-off step (39.1%) with quick layout configuration, though lacks support email evidence.
Clears up confusion reported in 3 support emails for the 35.2% finish drop step; cost is minimal text update.
